name: Cutie & Her Uncle
source:
Shannie is the sweetest thing. Studying an hour a day,  baking cookies for her friends just to see them smile...

It sure doesn't help that this innocent virgin is the sexiest, most gorgeous girl you've ever seen.

You used to be nothing more than a loving uncle  - but as you reunite with her on her 18th birthday, you can't help but see in her a new light. Perhaps, with a little discipline, you might bring out this good girl's bad side - but don't let her father, your brother, find out!

[From Itch.io]
translation:
珊妮是最可爱的人。每天学习一小时，为朋友们烤饼干，只是为了看到他们的微笑……

这个天真的处女是你见过的最性感、最漂亮的女孩，这肯定没有帮助。

你曾经只不过是一位慈爱的叔叔，但当你在她18岁生日那天与她重聚时，你不禁在她身上看到了新的光芒。也许，通过一点纪律，你可能会暴露出这个好女孩的坏的一面 - 但不要让她的父亲，你的兄弟发现！

[来自Itch.io]
